# KatanaKit

> A sharp, framework-agnostic TypeScript service toolkit organized with hexagonal architecture.

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://senseikatana.github.io/getting-started.md): Install and configure KatanaKit, then use its core services.
- [Architecture](https://senseikatana.github.io/architecture.md): Hexagonal architecture, layer breakdown, design patterns and conventions.

## Guides

- [Deploy](https://senseikatana.github.io/guides/deploy.md): How to deploy applications using KatanaKit.

## Reference

- [API Overview](https://senseikatana.github.io/api-overview.md): Complete reference for katanakit-js services and adapters.
- [Changelog](https://senseikatana.github.io/changelog.md): All notable changes to katanakit-js.
- [Roadmap](https://senseikatana.github.io/roadmap.md): What is planned for KatanaKit. Contributions welcome.

## Other

- [KatanaKit](https://senseikatana.github.io/index.md): A sharp, framework-agnostic TypeScript service toolkit organized with hexagonal architecture.
